· 현재가(24,775원) vs SMA5(28,680원)/SMA20(30,050원)/SMA50(34,064원): 단기·중기 추세 하회, 약세 진단

· 52주 위치(20.1%) + 현 가격대 52주 저가(16,760원) 대비 높은 수준

· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (하단 25,301원): 하단선 근접, 과매도 압력 증가
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 (23,100원): 주봉 SMA100(23,005원)과 근접, 주요 지지 구간
· 스윙 저항선 (30,570원): 단기 반등 시 첫 저항 구간
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Lower High 지속): 하락 추세 확인, 회복 신호 미발생
[거래량·결론]

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (24,775 KRW) vs SMA5 (28,680 KRW)/SMA20 (30,050 KRW)/SMA50 (34,064 KRW): below short/mid-term trends, bearish diagnosis.
· Significantly below SMA100 (37,163 KRW)/SMA200 (36,407 KRW): weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (20.1%) + current price level is higher relative to 52-week low (16,760 KRW).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.1 → 32.1): continuing into oversold territory, downward momentum maintained.
· MACD histogram trajectory (94.7976 → -276.1572): bearish expansion continuing, downward trend strengthening after dead cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (lower band 25,301 KRW): approaching lower band, increasing oversold pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (23,100 KRW): close to weekly SMA100 (23,005 KRW), key support zone.
· Swing resistance (30,570 KRW): first resistance zone on a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High continuation): confirming downtrend, no recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.47x): increased volume on recent decline, indicating strengthening selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): potential for short-term bounce attempt due to oversold entry and proximity to key support, considering buy entry.
